description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ModelFilters' that provides UI filters for a collection of model groups including search, provider, mode, and feature filters. It manages internal state, computes filtered data based on user input, and exposes filtering state and reset functionality.

methods.name: getUniqueProviders
methods.description: Extracts unique provider names from the provided model data.

methods.name: getUniqueModes
methods.description: Extracts unique mode values from the model data.

methods.name: getUniqueFeatures
methods.description: Extracts unique features supported by models, based on 'supports_' boolean keys.

methods.name: filteredData (useMemo)
methods.description: Memoized computation of filtered model data based on search and filter criteria.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filter states to their initial values.
